crack_pattern: Diagonal crack at about 45 degrees near the beam support
urgency: Immediate: restrict access and call a structural engineer
root_causes: Insufficient shear reinforcement or stirrup spacing

recommended_repairs.details: Prop the member and remove live load immediately.
Jacket the beam or bond FRP wraps as designed by a structural engineer.
Inject cracks once the strengthening scheme is approved.

monitoring_plan: Install crack monitors and review daily until the strengthening is complete.
summary: A wide diagonal crack at a support is a classic shear failure sign. Treat the member as unsafe until it is propped and assessed.
